# Clarity Chat - Complete Documentation

> Enterprise-grade React component library for building beautiful, accessible AI chat interfaces. Features 70+ production-ready components, 35+ custom hooks, 11+ themes, and comprehensive token optimization. Built with TypeScript, React 19, and Tailwind CSS.

This document contains the complete documentation for Clarity Chat in a single file optimized for AI consumption.

---

## Installation

Install Clarity Chat using your preferred package manager:

```bash
# npm
npm install @clarity-chat/react

# pnpm
pnpm add @clarity-chat/react

# yarn
yarn add @clarity-chat/react
```

### Peer Dependencies

Clarity Chat requires the following peer dependencies:

- React 19+
- React DOM 19+

### Basic Setup

```tsx
import { ClarityChat } from '@clarity-chat/react';
import '@clarity-chat/react/dist/styles/index.css';

function App() {
  return <ClarityChat />;
}
```

---

## Core Components

### ClarityChat

All-in-one chat component with built-in state management, streaming support, and token optimization.

```tsx
import { ClarityChat } from '@clarity-chat/react';

function Chat() {
  const handleSend = async (message: string) => {
    // Send message to your API
  };

  return (
    <ClarityChat
      messages={messages}
      onSend={handleSend}
      isLoading={isLoading}
      theme="default"
      enableStreaming
      enableVoice
      enableFileUpload
    />
  );
}
```

**Props:**
- `messages` (Message[], required): Array of chat messages
- `onSend` ((message: string) => void, required): Send message callback
- `isLoading` (boolean): Shows loading/thinking indicator
- `theme` (Theme): Visual theme
- `enableStreaming` (boolean): Enable real-time streaming
- `enableVoice` (boolean): Enable voice input
- `enableFileUpload` (boolean): Enable file attachments

### ChatWindow

Container component for chat interfaces with responsive design.

```tsx
import { ChatWindow, MessageList, ChatInput } from '@clarity-chat/react';

function CustomChat() {
  return (
    <ChatWindow height="600px" showHeader>
      <MessageList messages={messages} />
      <ChatInput onSend={handleSend} />
    </ChatWindow>
  );
}
```

### MessageList

Display chat messages with virtualization support for large conversations.

```tsx
import { MessageList } from '@clarity-chat/react';

<MessageList
  messages={messages}
  virtualize={messages.length > 100}
  groupByDate
  showTimestamps
  onMessageAction={(action, message) => {
    // Handle copy, edit, delete
  }}
/>
```

### ChatInput

User input with text, voice, attachments, and keyboard shortcuts.

```tsx
import { ChatInput } from '@clarity-chat/react';

<ChatInput
  onSend={handleSend}
  placeholder="Ask me anything..."
  enableVoice
  enableAttachments
  maxLength={4000}
/>
```

### StreamingMessage

Real-time streaming response display with typing animation.

```tsx
import { StreamingMessage } from '@clarity-chat/react';

<StreamingMessage
  content={streamingContent}
  isStreaming={isLoading}
  typingSpeed={50}
  showCursor
/>
```

### ThinkingIndicator

Animated loading indicator for AI processing states.

```tsx
import { ThinkingIndicator } from '@clarity-chat/react';

{isLoading && <ThinkingIndicator variant="dots" />}
```

**Variants:** 'dots' | 'pulse' | 'wave' | 'spinner'

### TokenCounter

Real-time token usage display with cost estimation.

```tsx
import { TokenCounter } from '@clarity-chat/react';

<TokenCounter
  tokens={currentTokens}
  limit={128000}
  showCost
  model="gpt-4"
  variant="detailed"
/>
```

## Core Hooks

### useChat

Primary hook for managing chat state, messages, and operations.

```tsx
import { useChat } from '@clarity-chat/react';

function ChatComponent() {
  const {
    messages,
    input,
    setInput,
    handleSubmit,
    isLoading,
    error,
    append,
    reload,
    stop,
  } = useChat({
    api: '/api/chat',
    initialMessages: [],
    onError: (error) => console.error(error),
  });

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      <MessageList messages={messages} />
      <input
        value={input}
        onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
        placeholder="Type a message..."
      />
      <button disabled={isLoading}>Send</button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

**Returns:**
- `messages`: Array of chat messages
- `input`: Current input value
- `setInput`: Set input value
- `handleSubmit`: Form submit handler
- `isLoading`: Loading state
- `error`: Current error
- `append`: Append a message
- `reload`: Regenerate last response
- `stop`: Stop streaming

### useStreaming

Handle streaming responses with SSE or WebSocket.

```tsx
import { useStreaming } from '@clarity-chat/react';

function StreamingChat() {
  const { data, isStreaming, start, stop, error } = useStreaming({
    url: '/api/chat/stream',
    protocol: 'sse',
    onChunk: (chunk) => console.log('Received:', chunk),
    onComplete: (fullText) => console.log('Complete:', fullText),
  });

  return (
    <div>
      <p>{data}</p>
      <button onClick={() => start({ message: 'Hello' })}>Start</button>
      {isStreaming && <button onClick={stop}>Stop</button>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### useTokenTracker

Track token usage and estimate API costs.

```tsx
import { useTokenTracker } from '@clarity-chat/react';

function TokenDisplay({ messages }) {
  const {
    totalTokens,
    inputTokens,
    outputTokens,
    estimatedCost,
    percentUsed,
    isOverLimit,
    countTokens,
  } = useTokenTracker({
    model: 'gpt-4',
    messages,
    limit: 128000,
  });

  return (
    <div>
      <span>{totalTokens} tokens ({percentUsed}%)</span>
      <span>Est. cost: ${estimatedCost.toFixed(4)}</span>
      {isOverLimit && <span>Warning: Over limit!</span>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### useTokenOptimization

Optimize token usage through compression and pruning.

```tsx
import { useTokenOptimization } from '@clarity-chat/react';

function OptimizedChat({ messages }) {
  const {
    optimizedMessages,
    originalTokens,
    optimizedTokens,
    savings,
    optimize,
  } = useTokenOptimization({
    messages,
    targetTokens: 4000,
    strategy: 'compress', // 'prune' | 'compress' | 'summarize'
  });

  return (
    <div>
      <span>Saved {savings}% tokens</span>
      <MessageList messages={optimizedMessages} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### useAutoScroll

Auto-scroll to new messages with user pause detection.

```tsx
import { useAutoScroll } from '@clarity-chat/react';

function ChatMessages({ messages }) {
  const containerRef = useRef(null);
  const { isAtBottom, scrollToBottom, isPaused } = useAutoScroll({
    ref: containerRef,
    dependency: [messages],
    behavior: 'smooth',
  });

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef}>
      {messages.map((m) => <Message key={m.id} {...m} />)}
      {!isAtBottom && (
        <button onClick={scrollToBottom}>New messages</button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### useClipboard

Copy text to clipboard with success feedback.

```tsx
import { useClipboard } from '@clarity-chat/react';

function CopyButton({ text }) {
  const { copy, copied, error } = useClipboard({ timeout: 2000 });

  return (
    <button onClick={() => copy(text)}>
      {copied ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy'}
    </button>
  );
}
```

### useKeyboardShortcuts

Register and manage keyboard shortcuts.

```tsx
import { useKeyboardShortcuts } from '@clarity-chat/react';

function Chat() {
  useKeyboardShortcuts([
    { key: 'Enter', modifiers: ['cmd'], action: handleSubmit },
    { key: 'Escape', action: clearInput },
    { key: 'k', modifiers: ['cmd'], action: openSearch },
  ]);

  return <ChatComponent />;
}
```

### useVoiceInput

Speech recognition for voice-to-text input.

```tsx
import { useVoiceInput } from '@clarity-chat/react';

function VoiceChat() {
  const {
    isListening,
    transcript,
    startListening,
    stopListening,
    isSupported,
  } = useVoiceInput({
    language: 'en-US',
    continuous: false,
  });

  if (!isSupported) return <p>Voice not supported</p>;

  return (
    <div>
      <button onClick={isListening ? stopListening : startListening}>
        {isListening ? 'Stop' : 'Start'} Recording
      </button>
      <p>{transcript}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### useErrorRecovery

Automatic error recovery with retry and backoff.

```tsx
import { useErrorRecovery } from '@clarity-chat/react';

function ReliableChat() {
  const {
    error,
    retryCount,
    isRetrying,
    retry,
    reset,
    execute,
  } = useErrorRecovery({
    maxRetries: 3,
    backoffMs: 1000,
  });

  const sendMessage = async (text) => {
    await execute(() => api.sendMessage(text));
  };

  return (
    <div>
      {error && (
        <div>
          <p>Error: {error.message}</p>
          <button onClick={retry}>Retry</button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Utility Hooks

### useDebounce

```tsx
const debouncedValue = useDebounce(value, 300);
```

### useLocalStorage

```tsx
const [value, setValue] = useLocalStorage('key', defaultValue);
```

### useMediaQuery

```tsx
const isMobile = useMediaQuery('(max-width: 768px)');
```

## Theming

Clarity Chat includes 11+ pre-built themes:

- default
- dark
- light
- ocean
- forest
- sunset
- midnight
- rose
- lavender
- mint
- slate

```tsx
import { ClarityChat, ThemeSelector } from '@clarity-chat/react';

function ThemedChat() {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState('default');

  return (
    <div>
      <ThemeSelector value={theme} onChange={setTheme} />
      <ClarityChat theme={theme} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Custom Themes

```tsx
import { createTheme } from '@clarity-chat/react';

const customTheme = createTheme({
  colors: {
    primary: '#6366f1',
    secondary: '#8b5cf6',
    background: '#ffffff',
    foreground: '#1f2937',
  },
  fonts: {
    sans: 'Inter, sans-serif',
    mono: 'JetBrains Mono, monospace',
  },
  borderRadius: '0.5rem',
});
```

## Token Optimization

Reduce API costs by up to 70% with Clarity Chat's token optimization features.

### Context Compression

```tsx
import { useTokenOptimization } from '@clarity-chat/react';

const { optimizedMessages, savings } = useTokenOptimization({
  messages,
  strategy: 'compress',
  targetTokens: 4000,
});
```

### Smart Caching

```tsx
import { useSmartCache } from '@clarity-chat/react';

const { getCachedResponse, cacheResponse } = useSmartCache({
  maxSize: 100,
  ttl: 3600000, // 1 hour
});
```

### Token Budget Monitor

```tsx
import { TokenOptimizationDashboard } from '@clarity-chat/react';

<TokenOptimizationDashboard
  currentTokens={tokens}
  limit={128000}
  onOptimize={handleOptimize}
/>
```

## Streaming Integration

### Server-Sent Events (SSE)

```tsx
import { useStreamingSSE } from '@clarity-chat/react';

const { data, isStreaming, start } = useStreamingSSE({
  url: '/api/chat/stream',
});
```

### WebSocket

```tsx
import { useStreamingWebSocket } from '@clarity-chat/react';

const { data, isConnected, send } = useStreamingWebSocket({
  url: 'wss://api.example.com/chat',
});
```

## Accessibility

Clarity Chat is WCAG 2.1 AAA compliant with:

- Full keyboard navigation
- Screen reader optimized
- High contrast support
- Reduced motion support
- Focus management
- ARIA labels and roles

```tsx
import { useKeyboardShortcuts, useReducedMotion } from '@clarity-chat/react';

function AccessibleChat() {
  const prefersReducedMotion = useReducedMotion();

  return (
    <ClarityChat
      animationDuration={prefersReducedMotion ? 0 : 300}
    />
  );
}
```

<ApiTokenManager

## Common Patterns

### Basic Chat with OpenAI

```tsx
import { ClarityChat, useChat } from '@clarity-chat/react';

function OpenAIChat() {
  const { messages, input, setInput, handleSubmit, isLoading } = useChat({
    api: '/api/chat',
  });

  return (
    <ClarityChat
      messages={messages}
      input={input}
      onInputChange={setInput}
      onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      isLoading={isLoading}
    />
  );
}

// API Route (Next.js)
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { messages } = await req.json();

  const response = await openai.chat.completions.create({
    model: 'gpt-4',
    messages,
    stream: true,
  });

  return new Response(response.body);
}
```

### RAG Document Chat

```tsx
import { ClarityChat, useChat, useRAGPipeline } from '@clarity-chat/react';

function RAGChat() {
  const { search, results } = useRAGPipeline({
    vectorStore: pinecone,
    embeddings: openai,
  });

  const { messages, handleSubmit } = useChat({
    onSend: async (message) => {
      const context = await search(message);
      // Include context in API call
    },
  });

  return <ClarityChat messages={messages} onSubmit={handleSubmit} />;
}
```

### Agent with Tools

```tsx
import { ClarityChat, useAgent } from '@clarity-chat/react';

function AgentChat() {
  const { messages, executeTask } = useAgent({
    tools: [
      { name: 'search', fn: searchWeb },
      { name: 'calculate', fn: calculator },
      { name: 'weather', fn: getWeather },
    ],
  });

  return <ClarityChat messages={messages} />;
}
```

## Migration from Vercel AI SDK

```tsx
// Before (Vercel AI SDK)
import { useChat } from 'ai/react';

// After (Clarity Chat)
import { useChat } from '@clarity-chat/react';

// API is largely compatible
const { messages, input, handleSubmit } = useChat();
```

See full migration guide: https://clarity-chat.dev/learn/migration/from-vercel-ai-sdk
